cap:info.cap:headline: Weather Update over Southern Ghana
cap:info.cap:description: Series of rain clouds formed in the Gulf of Guinea, the coastal and middle sectors are expected to continue producing moderate to heavy scattered thunderstorms and rain this afternoon and into the evening hours. Some areas are likely to experience moderate to strong winds.
cap:info.cap:instruction: Avoid taking shelter under trees and weak structures. Motorists should reduce speed, use headlights, and avoid crossing flooded roads or low-lying bridges. Those in flood-prone or riverside communities should stay alert for further updates. Stay updated with official information from the Ghana Meteorological Agency. In an emergency, contact NADMO on 0302 964 884 / 0291 913 077or dial 112.
